Name: The Old Road
Description: The caravan can't reach the ruins while the Barrow Lord holds the gate. Clear the way and make camp.

Steps.Text: Fell the Barrow Lord at the gate
Reach the camp in the ruins

Name: A Word with the Lorekeeper
Description: The crew's lorekeeper teaches what the books describe. Introduce yourself.

Steps.Text: Speak to the skill trainer in the camp

Name: Under the Ruins
Description: Stairs lead down from the camp into an archive that should be empty. Something is turning the pages.

Steps.Text: Take the sealed scroll it was guarding

Name: The Sealed Way
Description: The scroll's seals describe a place. The podium in the ruins can read them aloud.

Steps.Text: Place a sealed warp scroll on the podium
Finish a portal run and come home

Name: Words on Paper
Description: Skill books turn up on bosses and on those who can read. The trainer will make sense of one.

Steps.Text: Hand a skill book to the skill trainer

Name: Thin the Warrens
Description: Goblins have overrun the Mirewood. The caravan would sleep better with fewer of them.

Steps.Text: Enter the Mirewood through the portal

Name: The Captain's Head
Description: The bandits answer to one voice. Wherever a Bandit Captain holds court, bring them down.
